ArtifactKind.description: Closed artifact families participating in a composed operation.

ArtifactReference.description: Identifies an immutable artifact participating in a composed operation.

digest.description: Content digest when the resolver can supply one.

ConceptRef.description: A reference to a concept in a dependent scheme. Resolved to a full Assertion during guide evaluation.

category.description: Category ID: required when the concept belongs to multiple categories.

id.description: Concept ID: must exist in one of the guide's target schemes.

value.description: Value for text-input concepts (e.g., country codes, project names).

GuideRuleOutcome.description: The effect of a guide rule: what it contributes to the marking.

concepts.description: Direct concept references: converted to assertions, then engine.process()'d.

rendered.description: Pre-rendered marking string: parsed by engine.process() during evaluation.

RuleReference.description: Identifies the exact resolved semantics of one policy rule.

ruleDigest.description: RFC 8785/SHA-256 digest of the canonical resolved rule content.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier within the owning artifact.

description: Per-rule breakdown in a guide evaluation result.

isComputed.description: Whether the rule was activated from other guide facts.

outcome.description: Rule outcome evaluated by the guide engine.

overriddenBy.description: Qualified overriding rule when this outcome was replaced.

rule.description: Qualified rule whose outcome was evaluated.

wasOverridden.description: Whether an active rule replaced this rule's outcome.
